description: This file defines an API client for interacting with a backend service that manages Slack query tracking. It includes functions for fetching and saving channel configurations, managing queries (list, create, update, delete), triggering Slack fetches, and exporting data to Excel. It handles fetch responses and provides a standardized interface for the frontend to communicate with the backend API.

methods.name: handleResponse(res)
methods.description: Internal helper to process fetch responses, parse JSON, handle errors based on response status and content type.

methods.name: getChannelConfig()
methods.description: Fetches the current Slack channel configuration from the backend API.

methods.name: saveChannelConfig(payload)
methods.description: Saves or updates the Slack channel configuration by sending a payload to the backend API.

methods.name: listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, status = '', search = '' } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of queries with optional filtering based on page, size, status, and search term.

methods.name: createQuery(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new query entry in the backend system.

methods.name: updateQuery(id, payload)
methods.description: Updates an existing query by its ID, supporting partial updates.

methods.name: deleteQuery(id)
methods.description: Deletes a query identified by its ID from the backend.

methods.name: fetchFromSlack()
methods.description: Triggers a Slack fetch operation on the backend, returning job or task info.

methods.name: exportToExcel()
methods.description: Requests the backend to generate an Excel export and returns the resulting Blob for download.

ctags.name: listQueries
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, status = '', search = '' } = {}) {$/
